name: mobile-canvas
description: Run and control iOS Simulators and Android emulators in VS Code, with live video and Copilot-powered device automation.

mobileCanvas.backend.markdownDescription: Use the production legacy engine (default) or explicitly opt into the pinned official Ailoha Target Host. Reload the VS Code window after changing. Ailoha does not fall back after errors; app lifecycle uses canonical target operations, while app inventory without native classification, installation, recording and broader controls remain unsupported.

languageModelTools.name: mobileCanvas_selectedDevice
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns information about the device currently selected in the Mobile view.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Attach the device currently selected in the Mobile view.

languageModelTools.name: mobileCanvas_screenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Captures and returns a PNG screenshot of the device currently selected in the Mobile view.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Attach a current screenshot of the selected mobile device.

languageModelTools.name: mobileCanvas_uiTree
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the current accessibility UI tree for the device selected in the Mobile view.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Attach the current accessibility tree for the selected mobile device.
